articles.title: Bitmine made its largest ETH purchase this year despite Tom Lee's slowdown suggestion
articles.snippet: The company bought 111,942 ether last week worth $237 million, ramping up purchases to take advantage of ETH's drop below $2,200.

articles.title: StablR freezes USDR and EURR after attacker mints $13.5 million in unbacked tokens
articles.snippet: The breach, linked to a 1-of-3 multisig wallet weakness, allowed attackers to compromise a key and mint $13.5 million in unbacked tokens, netting them $2.8 million.

articles.title: XRP slips below $1.35 after triangle breakdown puts focus on $1.30 support
articles.snippet: XRP lost a key support zone after another failed breakout attempt, with traders now watching whether the months-long compression pattern resolves lower.

articles.title: UK authorities sanction HTX crypto exchange over support for Russia
articles.snippet: Formerly Huobi Global, the exchange is the latest entity to be named as part of a crackdown on companies “exploited by Russia to circumvent UK sanctions.”

articles.title: Ethereum treasury firms lean on staking as ETF pressure builds: Report
articles.snippet: Everstake said staking made up 60% of disclosed revenue among six Ethereum treasury firms, while loss-making companies posted $1.41 billion in losses.
